description:
You are a restaurant owner restructuring staff roles in Floreant POS. Create a new user type (role) named 'Shift Supervisor' using the Back Office administration.

Steps:
1. Click BACK OFFICE on the main terminal screen.
2. Enter password/PIN: 1111 and confirm.
3. In the Back Office, navigate to the User Type management area (look under Admin/Explorer menus).
4. Add a new user type with the name exactly: 'Shift Supervisor'.
5. Save the new user type.

The new user type must be saved to the database to complete the task.
